en: Black‑and‑white historic postcard showing a town square with rows of traditional European townhouses, small shops on the ground floors, a horse‑drawn carriage, and people gathered with carts in the square. Dominating the background is a tall Gothic church with a central spire and smaller flanking spires. The printed caption at the top reads "Neustadt i. Sa. Markt und Kirche". Additional signage on buildings includes the word "APOTHEKE" on a pharmacy and other German shop names.
